title: Dietary Credit on Privately Held Days: Therapeutic Opening Charge
content:
**Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations — the dietary credit on the therapeutic opening charge.**

*Why a credit?* Meals are not prepared for a resident on leave, so the therapeutic opening daily charge carries a dietary credit keyed to the bed held as the reservation records it and to the leave's length from the departure date through the therapeutic opening entry's last day, both days counted.

*How long must the leave be?* At least 4 days, counted from the departure date through the therapeutic opening entry's last day with both days included. A leave of 3 days takes no credit; a leave of 4 days does.

*How much?* 16.80 per day (the memory-unit dietary credit) where the bed held is on a secure memory care tier, that is a Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room or Private Secure Memory Care Room; 14.10 per day (the standard dietary credit) where it is on any other tier.

*Which tier is looked at?* The tier of the bed held as the reservation records it.
